in_sanskrit.name: मानस्विन्
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who is born from the mind or thoughts

in_marathi.name: Manasvin
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of mind
in_marathi.long_meaning: Manasvin हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Manasvin is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Manas' which means 'mind' and 'Vin' which means 'god'.
